title: Panel
description: Grouping surfaces, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: a heading over bordered panels, each with a title, a sentence and its own action, with empty, loading and error renders of its own; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — actions shrink to their label at @sm, two panels a row and a larger heading at @md, wider gaps at @lg.
